subject: history
concept: Applying community knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student designs a simple ideal community feature (park, helper role) based on a need they identify
exercise.pictorial: Student illustrates their community design idea
exercise.abstract: Student explains why their idea would help the community in a short response

assessment.mastery_threshold: idea is connected to a real, identifiable community need
misconception_flags: proposes an idea with no clear connection to any community need

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
